title: Second Shelf - Three Simple Story-Led Logo Directions
shared_constraints: no abstract symbol as primary mark

directions.name: The Next Book
directions.story: A hand places an open book on a small shelf.
directions.composition: close-up diagonal gesture with isolated shelf
directions.risk: the hand must remain recognizable without becoming realistic

directions.name: The Window Light
directions.story: A small hand pulls back a curtain to reveal a lamp and one book.
directions.risk: the window must stay open and readable at small sizes

directions.name: The Passing Book
directions.story: Two hands exchange one wrapped book.
directions.supporting_cue: thin neighborhood street line and one star
directions.risk: the exchange gesture must not look like a generic handshake

simple_story_rule.reduction_test: If the concept needs more than three major visual ideas, reduce it.

recommended_system.rule: Keep the primary identity illustration-led and simple. Derive any simplified mark from the chosen vignette rather than replacing it.

logo_distillation.distinctness_rule: Sibling directions must differ in silhouette and framing; do not repeat the same interior, character pairing, or object cluster.
